about.title: Leo's shop
paragraphs: Leo Auto Services is a hard-working Gresham shop on NW Birdsdale Ave. Leo tells you the truth about your car and does the work for a fair price.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Leo will get back to you. Or call (503) 957-4526 (Mon–Fri: 9am–6:30pm; Sat: 9am–2pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Leo will get back to you soon to set up a time.

services.name: Brakes
services.blurb: Pads, rotors, lines and brake inspections.
services.intro: Grinding, squealing or a soft pedal? We inspect the whole brake system and fix what needs fixing.

services.name: Electrical & Batteries
services.intro: Car won't start, battery keeps dying or something electrical acting up? We track it down.
